TEXT: And so...
I graduated from middle school,
became a high school student,
then graduated from high school...
...and became an university student.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...and like that, Kyousuke was being super-annoying.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Isn't it seriously unbelievable? This time I'm really 
fed up with him.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: ...I see, then will you break up with him?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Muh.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT:
If he gets dumped by his beloved girlfriend... that 
will end up as a chance for me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Y-You're still aiming for him?!

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: Oh my, didn't I say it before?

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: I will continue fighting you eternally into the future.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: No, just get a boyfriend of your own already!

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: I refuse.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT:
In the first place... do you think that someone that 
has trouble just making a single friend can get a 
lover?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Don't say it with such self-confidence!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Ah, geez... maybe I chose the wrong person to 
consult about love with.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT:
...What are you saying, fool? What you're doing isn't 
a love consultation, it's the grumbles of a lover's 
quarrel.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...Urgh.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT:
If you were seriously fed up with him... I wouldn't 
be in this kind of mood now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: That's true.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
If he did something horrible to me, you would 
definitely be angry.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: Isn't that obvious?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Now that I think about it, isn't it strange? You 
yourself are getting in the way of the guy you're 
aiming for, ending up single, aren't you?

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: It's just as you say. It truly is troubling.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...You're not denying it?

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT:
If someone I like is going to make a mistake, I have 
to do something, don't I?

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT:
If our positions were reversed, I'm sure you'd do 
the same thing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Yes, yes, maybe so.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Yes!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Kirino♪

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...Geh.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Geez, Kirino, what's with that "Geh"?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Ah, no, that is, you know.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: W-Why are you here Ayase... so unexpectedly?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
I came here due to some work close by. I wanted 
to see your face.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: You see me every day.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: That's true, but...
This is bad. What's bad, you ask...

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT:
What's wrong, Kirino? If we have a visitor, I'll get 
the tea...

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: Oh my.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Hello.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: What did you come here for?
......Why can't these two get along?
They've always been like this since they first met.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: I came to see Kirino's face today.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT:
I see. Well then, you've already finished your 
business here.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: No, actually, I brought a present with me...
Well, I'm happy, but...
She'll definitely quarrel with Kuroneko.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Wow, cakes.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Hehe, actually, I got this from Onee-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Seriously? I super-love the cakes the Tamuras 
make.
Don't look at me while sighing!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Really? But, aren't I intruding?

I want to follow the example of this feigned 
ignorance of hers.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Not at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Thank you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Umm, just grab a seat somewhere.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Ah, shall I help?

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: I'll do it. "Dear guest", please do sit down.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...Muh.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
Your words seem to have a hidden meaning 
somehow.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: Did it sound that way? My sincere apologies.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
Aah, I'm jealous of Kuroneko-san for 
being able to live together with Kirino, 
even if it's only for a [font_size=28]limited time.[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
You seem to have some spare rooms, so maybe I 
should also move in here.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: ...W-What?

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: D-Don't joke like that. Please stop it.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
Eh, but didn't you recently tell me "Let's get 
along"?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Don't tell me, that was a lie?

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: Of course that was a lie. I said it sarcastically.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...I never thought you'd respond like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Kirino~, Kuroneko-san is bullying me!
Ayase clutched onto me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Yes, yes, geez.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: I can't believe you two are the same age.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...Hahaha. So anyway, please take care of the tea.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: I intended to do so from the beginning.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Ooh~, looks like someone else has come.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: What's up?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Please pardon us.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Oh, you two, welcome.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
Kirino... your response is completely different from 
when I came.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: There's no way that could be.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: We've brought a present. It's a trivial thing, though...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: It's not trivial, since I'm the one that chose it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Wow, warabi-mochi from the Tamura Shop.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Kirino, you like them, right? Ehehe, I remembered.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Thank you, Kanako, Saori.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I'm glad that you're happy with them.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Since Ayase is here too, shall we all eat them 
together?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Yes.
